iterations.finding: Better stance than withdrawn v3, but fine painted pixel details wash out at 64px. The face loses its eyes and expression.

Body silhouette, stance, materials and kit continuity now work as a coherent RPG interpretation. Front/right faces remain too blank under the fringe; right cheek/nose is a pale wedge. Hair highlights are fragmented. Refine heads before handoff.

iterations.changes: 197 head pixel refinements consolidate swept hair locks, open the front face, separate eyes from fringe, shape the right cheek/nose/jaw and retain a slight front smile. Rebuilt and re-exported through native Blender MCP.
iterations.actualExportFinding: The producing agent finds an appealing, coherent RPG character: readable faces, natural weight and stance, clear materials, directional volume and retained concept identity. The final independent inspection found no aesthetic defect that blocks presenting the idle draft.
iterations.scaleAssessment: At 2x, front eyes and slight smile read, and the right eye/nose/jaw are distinct. At 1x, expression is subtle but character and facing stay clear.
iterations.interpretation: Shorter game proportions make the sprite younger-looking than the painted adult concept; outfit, hair, warm expression and character identity remain recognizable.
